markdown: **Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision, Interact ([linguistic](/Traits.aspx?ID=101), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You swipe the card over the head of an adjacent creature to delve into their thoughts. You cast [_mind probe_](/Spells.aspx?ID=193), but as a two-action spell rather than one that takes 1 minute to cast. The level of the spell is one-half your level, rounded down (minimum 5th level), and the save DC is your class DC.
